messages.subject: make/local ?
parts:
Do we need to have make/local checked into the repo?
It just gets in the way every time and I don't want to
have to explicitly add just so I don't add make/local
and overwrite the one on origin.

- Bob

messages.author: cab04b8f0759c712
messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] make/local ?
parts:
So... We can fix reasonably in one of two ways.

1. Add make/local to the assume unchanged list. You can do this by typing:
git update-index --assume-unchanged make/local

Although the file is in our gitignore, it isn't ignored because it is tracked. The advice line fixes that.

2. Remove make/local for dev versions and add it back in for every reload.

This info is on our wiki here. https://github.com/stan-dev/stan/wiki/Developer-Tricks#ignore-makelocal
